stageNote: All five scenarios are terminal. Three cover the reported declaration and its unchanged neighbour; two pin the boundary from each side so the guard cannot drift without a test noticing.
keyShapeNote: requiredTestType is e2e-ui because every scenario is stated in terms of what the Power view renders. The browser assertions live in tests/lifetime-tax-representable.spec.mjs; the engine-level and render-level guards behind them are additionally pinned by TB-020-04, TB-020-05 and TB-020-06 in scripts/selftest.mjs, each proven load-bearing by probes R1-R3 in report.md.

businessScenarioMapping.note: No business scenario applies. This is a correctness defect in a calculator's display seam, not a product surface change.

scenarios.title: a stage whose amount overflows the double range is refused by name

gherkin.given: a household declaring ordinary income and qualified dividends at 9e307 each
gherkin.when: the Power view renders the stage table
gherkin.then: every stage whose amount is not finite carries a named refusal

obligations.requiredProof: Every stage row whose amount is not finite carries a named RLTAX- refusal rather than a figure, asserted against the live route in the Power view.
The refusal names its domain, so the reader is told which quantity was unrepresentable instead of receiving an anonymous failure.

testMechanism.mechanismNote: The route under test is the real production route and nothing is intercepted. The rule pack is the committed same-origin file tax-rules/federal/2026.json, read the way the page reads it, so the arithmetic that overflows is the production arithmetic on production data. Only the declared INPUT is synthetic, and it has to be: no household reaches 9e307, which is why this defect survived to be found by a stabilize round rather than by use.
testMechanism.negativeControl: Probe R3 neutralises the E3 display-seam guard while leaving every assertion untouched; the non-finite value reaches the display record again and the assertion fails, so it is sensitive to the guard rather than merely to the page loading.
testMechanism.negativeControlMechanism: scripts/red-green-probe.sh, single literal mutation with verified revert; probe output recorded in report.md under '## Closing The Over-Determination Row'.

scenarios.title: the settlement header does not describe an unrepresentable result as settled

obligations.requiredProof: The settlement header does not read "Settled" for a declaration the route could not price, asserted against the live route.
The header names the unrepresentable domain, so an unsettled result is distinguishable from a settled one.

gherkin.given: a household declaring ordinary income and qualified dividends at 8.9e307 each
gherkin.when: the Power view renders the stage table

obligations.requiredProof: Every stage carries the same figure, rounding and rule status recorded in the pre-change observation, asserted against the live route.
No refusal appears on this declaration, so the guard is shown not to be on the accepting path at all.
